title: Whole-Leg Long Stroking
summary: Long continuous passes connect the lower leg and thigh while avoiding joints and the back of the knee.
goal: Connect separate leg regions into one sequence.
startingPosition: The entire leg rests stably and relaxed.
instructions: Move upward, reducing pressure near the knee.
Do not press behind the knee.
direction: Upward over the soft tissues of the leg.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
